body.statement: Two finite min-cost-flow problems compute \(L\) and \(U\). Optimal flows \(\gamma_L\in\Gamma_L\) and \(\gamma_U\in\Gamma_U\), normalized by \(p_c\) within each row, produce endpoint selectors, high-level SCMs, and all-intervention partial-projection certificates.
body.justification: The bound must return allocations that can be inspected as causal implementations.
body.gap: This is supporting finite transport machinery; its role is to make sharp SCM attainment auditable.
body.consumer: A regulator can inspect the worst-case context-by-drug allocation and its corresponding structural model.
